annotations.title: Base snapshot: gas + ETH price + network status

description: [PAID $0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Bundle for agents that check Base before acting: everything in /api/base/gas (base fee, priority-fee tiers, trend, congestion, USD cost of ETH transfer / ERC-20 transfer / swap incl. L1 data fee) + ETH/USD from Chainlink on Base, Coinbase spot and CoinGecko (median price, max-min deviationPct, 24h change) + network status: ok/degraded/stalled/sequencer-down from head block age, safe and finalized lag in blocks, and the Chainlink L2 sequencer uptime feed. One-line `summary` included. No params. Cached 5 s. Null = source unavailable (never invented). Errors are never charged.
